name: @wizeworks/billing
description: Platform billing - the WizeWorks subscription a tenant is charged for, out of the Stripe account its PLAN names (src/plans). A per_module plan bills one item per active module (sparx); a flat plan bills one base item plus capacity (Piggles). Lazy + idempotent customer/subscription provisioning, plan-shaped item sync, trial lifecycle, and webhook reconciliation scoped by account. Guarded so every operation is a no-op until that plan's key + price IDs are configured (dev/test never need Stripe).
